result.reason: The redline reaches the preferred position by providing professional and workmanlike services, 12-month technology conformance and 90-day services warranties, compliance with applicable laws, a malicious-code warranty, and re-performance, repair, replacement, or refund remedies, while appropriately carving these warranties out of the disclaimer. The changes are targeted and preserve the remaining disclaimer. Minor drafting issues include the potentially inconsistent use of “Licensed Software” instead of “Licensed Technology” and the awkward reference to refunding fees “payable.”
